blocks.title: AST Intel & Surgical Code Tools
blocks.summary: Babel & Python AST outline, symbol lookup, and surgical code read/edit with re-anchoring.

blocks.title: Out-of-Context Command Runner
blocks.summary: Non-polluting command runner with ANSI/secret stripping, disk logging, and receipt tokens.

blocks.title: Progressive Context Formatter
blocks.summary: L0-L3 progressive Markdown context serializer preventing context window blowout.

blocks.title: Workspace Coverage Guard
blocks.summary: Strict 100% workspace file coverage checker, preventing orphan code from entering tasks.

blocks.title: ContextOS Daemon (osd)
blocks.summary: Background daemon hosting project routers, persistent process monitoring, and IPC socket server.

blocks.title: Metro Map Subway Canvas
blocks.summary: SwiftUI subway rail network view, station nodes, orthogonal rail connections, and zoom/pan scene.

blocks.title: Desktop Native SQLite Store
blocks.summary: Swift native SQLite reader, reactive GraphStore publisher, and background file change watcher.

blocks.title: Inspector & Knowledge Reader
blocks.summary: Right drawer inspector, task journal, and rich Markdown knowledge document reader.

blocks.title: Environment & Plugin Synchronizer
blocks.summary: Editor configuration detection, Node path resolution, and one-click MCP plugin synchronization.

blocks.title: Desktop Window & App Shell
blocks.summary: Main desktop app entrypoint, window frame, global theme, and data models.

blocks.title: Architecture Invariant Guard
blocks.summary: Enforces zero ghost blocks, valid state machine transitions, and relational consistency.

blocks.title: Domain Entities & Knowledge Models
blocks.summary: Unified core entity definitions for Plans, Phases, Tasks, Blocks, Chains, Links, and Decision records.

blocks.title: Metro Line Layout Algorithm
blocks.summary: Metro rail graph layout algorithm with parallel rails and station spacing.

blocks.title: C-D-C-S Lifecycle Services
blocks.summary: PlanService, TaskService (C-D-C-S state machine), and KnowledgeService application coordination.

blocks.title: Consolidated 12 MCP Facades
blocks.summary: Twelve high-cohesion MCP facades covering context, lifecycle, code intelligence, receipts, process control, and project administration.

blocks.title: Process Supervisor & Tree Killer
blocks.summary: Long-running daemon process supervisor, heartbeat tracking, and clean process tree termination.

blocks.title: SQLite WAL Database Engine
blocks.summary: WAL-mode SQLite schema, atomic transactions, and relational projection persistence.

blocks.title: Git Bidirectional Sync Engine
blocks.summary: Deterministic graph.json export, Git checkout rollback detection, and state reconciliation.

blocks.title: Verification & Regression Suite
blocks.summary: Manual workflow scripts, unit suites, plugin smoke checks, and verification gates for ContextOS releases.
blocks.details: Owns executable regression coverage and release verification assets. Artifact Ledger tests were replaced by tree-binding, receipt-only, and migration checks.
